text:
maria-ipsen: Heads-up — I want to run a light-touch admin entitlement prune next month to keep our least-priv posture tidy. Target: staging first, prod only after canary. Quick sync: who can help with ownership evidence and KMS binding checks?
ryan: +1. I can handle the evidence queries. Suggestion: use a short-lived canary group and remove 10% of stale admin grants to start.
anna: what counts as 'stale' for this run? last activity only or last use of KMS grants as well?
maria-ipsen: prefer dual criteria: no console/API activity in 90d AND no KMS decrypt/grant usage in 120d. If either is recent, we keep.
ryan: I'll run a sampling query tomorrow. snippet: ```sql
SELECT principal, last_api_call, last_kms_use FROM access_events WHERE role IN ('admin','owner') AND last_api_call < now() - interval '90 days';```
sec-bot: auto-scan results: 24 admin principals flagged in prod by the heuristics above, 11 in staging. See /audit/reports/4112223333-prune-scan.csv
kyle-prodeng: heads-up — a blind bulk revoke will break a few infra owners (rotation jobs, build runners). We need a small pre-check: look for service accounts referenced by cronjobs or infra state. I can help map.
sre-oncall: also watch deploy windows. If we remove an admin who is still pinned in an ongoing deployment, we could cause a failure and an incident. Recommend scheduling prod prune during low-deploy hours and gate with a canary rollout.
anna: rollback plan? how do we re-grant quickly if something breaks?
maria-ipsen: plan: staged script with a dry-run flag, then canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 72h. Each stage waits 6h of telemetry (errors, auth failures). Rollback is an automated regrant using the owner map snapshot we capture before changes.
ryan: I'll capture owner_map and produce a JSON snapshot: `owner_map_4112223333.json`. Also will add a column for ``last_kms_activity`` so we can avoid false positives.
kyle-prodeng: Can we tag impacted principals with `prune-pending` rather than removing right away? That makes review easier and avoids immediate breakage.
maria-ipsen: good idea. Flow: tag -> wait 48h -> remove for canary. Tagging also creates an audit trail.
sec-bot: FYI: KMS binding check: found 3 principals with direct kms:Decrypt permissions via older policies (legacy-keyring). Recommend adding those to immediate manual review set.
sre-oncall: please also check our ephemeral elevation service (justin-elevate). Some jobs rely on ephemeral grants; removing underlying admin role could stop elevates from issuing.
anna: for RBAC change window, propose Thu 03:00–07:00 UTC for prod canary. Lower traffic and away from US business hours.
ryan: scheduling that window works for me. I'll run the audit queries beforehand and post the CSVs.
maria-ipsen: volunteers for manual verification of the 3 legacy KMS principals? need two people for cross-check.
kyle-prodeng: I can take one — will inspect deployment/cron references.
anna: I can take the other — will check CI pipelines and infra roles.
sec-bot: reminder (automated): please ensure `auditd` retention is set to 90 days for this operation. Current config: auditd.retention_days=60.
maria-ipsen: we'll bump retention to 120 for the prune window then revert. Ops, please add a changelog entry.
sre-oncall: I'll add a temporary monitoring rule to alert on increased `auth_failure` spikes during the prune window.
ryan: timeline proposal posted: https://redwood.internal/ops/prune/4112223333 — dry-run in staging next Wed, Thu canary in prod on Thu 03:00 UTC, full rollout gated.
maria-ipsen: thanks everyone. Action items: ryan = queries + owner snapshot, kyle & anna = manual review of flagged KMS principals, sre-oncall = monitoring + deploy window coordination, sec-bot = confirm audit retention. I'll draft the PR with the tagging + staged remove job and post for review by EOD. :thumbsup:
anna: :eyes: will review the PR once posted.
kyle-prodeng: :+1:
sec-bot: scan summary added to thread: /audit/logs/4112223333/summary.txt
maria-ipsen: end-of-thread note: keep communication in this thread during the operation, call pager if anything spikes. We'll meet 30m before the prod canary.
